facts.fact: Kate 早上在 Otley Road 看到大部分媒体已撤，只剩一小撮摄影记者和摄像师。
facts.anchor: Most of the media had gone, leaving only a stubborn clump

facts.fact: 警方公开表示两起谋杀之间没有证据关联，Kate 由此怀疑自己是否被自己的理论带偏。
facts.anchor: had stated there was no evidence linking the murders

facts.fact: Kate 在咖啡馆用 Facebook 找到 Emily 的旧室友 Alice Wheatley，并从其律所网站取到邮箱。
facts.anchor: She found Alice Wheatley on Facebook easily enough.

facts.fact: Smith 发短信说 Gloria 不愿开口，把门摔在他脸上。
Gloria 当面否认当天早上有人敲过门，说她一直在家。
facts.anchor: No one has come all morning.

facts.fact: Gloria 说 Aiden 亲口告诉她他去见了 Olivia，并称自己当时很震惊。
facts.anchor: He told me,’ Jessop replied, looking past Kate into the room beyond.

facts.fact: Gloria 用 Crawley 夫妇家的聚会为 Aiden 在 Emily 遇害当晚提供不在场证明。
facts.anchor: He was at our friends’ party that night.

facts.fact: Gloria 断言 Emily 的死是一次入室盗窃失手，拒绝接受其他解释。
facts.anchor: It was a burglary gone wrong.
